known_findings.detail: AGENTS.md states _site-exit-inject.js gave 24 full-viewport renderers a site exit link. The SWR-SITE-EXIT marker is on ZERO of the 26 pages that codemod declares; its 31 files are all in pending. Either the codemod was reverted wholesale or it was never run. check-site-chrome.mjs does not catch this because those pages are exempt from the shared-footer rule.

_library-loader-inject.js is applied to all 13 of its engines, but its idempotency guard does not recognise its own output: every run prints 'no matchable library boot block' for 13 pages and exits 1 while writing nothing. Cosmetic (no data loss) but it makes the codemod unusable as a dry-run signal until the guard is taught the v2 shape.

_library-loader-inject.js's own coverage scan reports bachdrop.html as MISSING_LIBRARY: the page carries the #swr-start overlay but has no library wiring. bachdrop is in no codemod's allowlist, so no marker check covers it. It is the one page whose exit-1 the codemod exits on.

_fx-grade-inject.js is superseded and inert: its regex expects filter('args') but the pages use ctx.filter = 'string', so a dry-run reports 0 migrations while its SWR-FX-GRADE-MARKER comment still sits on 11 pages and gpu-grade.client.js is loaded and unused there. scripts/check-variant-codemods.mjs carries the same note. Removing the dead markers is a separate cleanup.

film.html is marked as _blend-shuffle applied but the codemod would still rewrite it: its exact blend-array anchor no longer matches film.html's remap() line, so the page has the __shuffle_once helper but not the rewritten pick. film is the only one of the 5 in this state.

_30s-inject.notes: Adds the rec-dur auto-stop <select> plus autoStopAt/autoStopTimer to the inline Recorder. Oldest codemod in the tree; targets the 5 core variants, not the reactive 13.

_audio-damp-inject.notes: Loads lib/audio-damp.client.js in every versions/*.html. Honours --dry-run.

_audio-overlay-inject.notes: Adds the #swr-start auto-load overlay + IIFE. The marker is the v3 failure-path guard (`var succeeded = false;`), which is what distinguishes the current canonical overlay from the v1/v2/v3-old shapes this codemod still repairs.

_blend-shuffle.notes: Replaces the deterministic [i%N] remap blend pick with a runtime shuffle. grid takes the `_shuffledCells` branch; the other four take `__shuffle_once`. Marker mode is `any` because the two branches are mutually exclusive per page.

_canvas-hints-inject.notes: Adds the willReadFrequently hint to the stage canvas context so per-frame getImageData stops tripping Chrome's readback warning.

_drive-inject.notes: Adds the Google Drive import button, its CSS and its three client scripts. Self-filters: skips the 7 non-variant pages and any page with no #load-song button. Honours --dry-run.

_fx-grade-inject.pending_reason: DEAD CODEMOD. Its regex expects the filter-syntax `filter('args')` but the pages on disk use `ctx.filter = 'string'`, so a dry-run reports 0 migrations. The markers below are leftovers from a previous era; they are inert (gpu-grade.client.js is loaded and harmlessly unused) and removing them is a separate cleanup. See scripts/check-variant-codemods.mjs for the same note.
_fx-grade-inject.notes: Moves the per-frame 2D ctx.filter grade chain onto the GPU pass in lib/gpu-grade.client.js. Honours --dry-run. Superseded in practice by _svg-grade-inject.js.

_genops-inject.notes: Wires the generative control system (engine-genops.css + .client.js) and routes Math.random() in the generative paths through the seeded RNG. Both markers are required: a partially patched page can have the assets without the shim.

_image-evolve-inject.notes: Wraps each variant's per-layer reactive result in SWR_RENDER.imageEvolve() so IMAGE layers drift with a seeded Ken Burns. Only covers the pages that recompute r locally inside their own drawLayer; the pass-through pages (smoke, watercolor, grid) are covered by the module patch alone.

_image-load-inject.notes: Extends the per-frame asset-not-ready guard from video-only to images too.

_library-loader-inject.notes: Routes the library load through client/library-loader.client.js (two-phase load). Carries a trailing coverage scan that exits 1 when a page has the #swr-start overlay but no library wiring - bachdrop.html is that page today.

_mobile-header-inject.notes: Adds data-icon glyphs to each header control plus the <= 480px icons-only CSS. Two markers by design: the CSS one is the idempotency guard, the HTML one stops a re-run adding the attributes twice.

_recorder-inject.notes: Injects the inline Recorder block (MediaRecorder over stage.captureStream + the audio track) and moves the window.SWR exposure after it so Recorder is defined when the exposure runs.

_render-inject.notes: Routes the render loop through engine-render.client.js (DPR-aware fit + per-layer cache + invalidate hook). NOTE: this codemod has NO <!-- SWR-RENDER-MARKER --> comment. Its fingerprint is the code it emits - `SWR_RENDER.fit(stage)` and `SWR_RENDER.frame(` - and both are required. scripts/check-variant-codemods.mjs attributes SWR-HEADER-DATA-ICONS to it, which is wrong: that marker belongs to _mobile-header-inject.

_responsive-inject.notes: Collapses the 220px/1fr/240px engine grid to a single column below 720px and lets the header wrap and scroll. Inserts at the same .swr-watermark anchor as _mobile-header-inject, so the two blocks stack.

_shuffle-inject.notes: Replaces the deterministic greedy top-1 pick in Layers.remap() with a weighted random pick from the top 2-3 candidates. The marker is the `const pool = cands.slice(...)` line the replacement introduces, NOT the `const topN =` line above it: _genops-inject rewrote Math.random() to _rnd() inside that same remap() block, so the topN line reads `Math.floor(_rnd()*2)` on every page that also got genops. The pool line is untouched by genops and identical on all 15 pages that carry it.

_site-exit-inject.pending_reason: AGENTS.md claims this codemod gave 24 full-viewport renderers a site exit link; on disk the marker is on ZERO of its 26 declared pages. The 31 files listed in pending are the honest state - the codemod has never been applied, or its output was reverted wholesale. Run it (or confirm the design changed) rather than letting this age out.
_site-exit-inject.notes: Injects <!-- SWR-SITE-EXIT --><a class="swr-site-exit" href="/"> after the transport <header>. The only codemod that reaches outside versions/, so it also owns tools/ and auth/ pages - see extra_pages.

_svg-grade-inject.notes: Moves the audio-driven ctx.filter grade chain onto the SVG filter graph in lib/svg-grade.client.js. Honours --dry-run. Only smoke.html has a single plain audio-driven chain today; the other 31 are correctly skipped.

_tone-slider-inject.pending_reason: collage / spectrum / typography carry the intensity slider but were never given the tone mount, because this codemod ran before they gained an FX or versions-presets consumer. Running it is the fix.
_tone-slider-inject.notes: Mounts the tone/desaturation slider (lib/tone-slider.client.js) beside the existing intensity slider. Self-filters on the presence of intensity-slider plus an fx-postprocess or versions-presets consumer.

_watermark-inject.notes: Loads lib/watermark.client.js so recorded media carries the SWR mark. The renderers capture stage.captureStream directly, so the on-page .swr-watermark DOM overlay never reached an export. Honours --dry-run.

_command-center-inject.notes: Adds the shared Studio Command Center to the 13 full engine surfaces — the ones with a Layers stack, a Library and a live output canvas. The six stub pages (baroque, gallery, kraft, mosaic, phosphor, tape) have none of those, so the Command Center would open onto empty panels there. This is the same allowlist _genops-inject.js uses. What it injects is the LAUNCHER (lib/command-center-launcher.client.js, ~2 KB), not the implementation: the implementation and its stylesheet load on demand the first time the button is used, so a variant visitor who never opens the Command Center does not download its 67 KB. Renders nothing until opened: a launcher button in the corner, or ?cc=1.
